create_gt_pose_results: create a perfect pose results CSV file from ground truth annotations and test targets for a BOP dataset
run_gt_results_for_dataset: run the script to generate ground truth pose results for the ycbv dataset test split with default parameters
generate_results_with_visibility_filter: generate pose results from ground truth filtering objects by minimum visibility percentage using visib_gt_min
load_and_save_bop_results: load scene ground truth data and save BOP pose results to a CSV file using inout utilities
create_results_for_custom_split: create ground truth pose results for a custom dataset split and evaluation mode via command line arguments
